products.text:
Type: round metal pedestal side table
Use: holding drinks, books, a lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: cast metal, gunmetal finish, raised tray top
Colors: dark gunmetal grey, bronze undertones
Shape: round tray top with lipped edge, thin hand-forged stem, three splayed curved legs, tall and slender, compact, light visual weight
Feel: sculptural, moody, refined
Goes with: leather sofas, dark wood, brass accents, neutral walls; industrial or modern rooms

Type: drop-leaf storage dining table
Use: small-space dining, extra surface, storage; dining room, kitchen, small apartment
Style: mid-century modern, rustic, contemporary
Materials: solid wood, chevron veneer leaves, brass bar pulls
Colors: warm medium brown wood, brass
Shape: narrow cabinet body with one drawer and one door, two fold-down leaves, square block legs, compact when folded, solid and boxy
Feel: warm, practical, cozy
Goes with: cream walls, brass accents, woven textiles; mid-century or small modern rooms

Type: rectangular wood dining table
Use: family dining, gatherings; dining room, kitchen
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: solid wood, oak grain finish
Colors: dark warm brown wood
Shape: long rectangular top, straight apron, four tapered square legs, sturdy and large, simple clean lines
Feel: warm, grounded, timeless
Goes with: upholstered or wood chairs, beige or white walls, iron accents; traditional or farmhouse dining rooms

Type: counter-height reclaimed wood dining table
Use: casual dining with bar stools; dining room, kitchen, open-plan living
Style: rustic, farmhouse, industrial
Materials: reclaimed fir planks, natural distressed finish
Colors: light warm honey wood
Shape: thick plank rectangular top, two ladder-rung trestle ends with horizontal slats, tall and long, chunky solid frame
Feel: rustic, relaxed, sociable
Goes with: metal or wood bar stools, white walls, black iron accents; farmhouse or industrial rooms

Type: round slatted patio dining table
Use: outdoor dining; patio, deck, garden
Style: contemporary, classic, modern
Materials: powder-coated metal slats, umbrella hole
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black
Shape: round slatted top with center umbrella hole, ring base frame, four splayed tubular legs, open and airy, medium size
Feel: practical, open, casual
Goes with: metal or sling patio chairs, outdoor umbrellas, stone paving; outdoor terraces

Type: round glass-top dining table
Use: dining for small groups; dining room, kitchen, breakfast nook
Style: contemporary, modern, classic
Materials: rubberwood frame, dark espresso finish, inset tempered glass top
Colors: dark espresso brown, smoky clear glass
Shape: round glass top in wood ring, four angled square legs meeting in cross stretcher, light and open, medium size
Feel: sleek, elegant, airy
Goes with: dark wood or upholstered chairs, cream walls, chrome accents; contemporary dining rooms

Type: expandable trestle dining table
Use: family dining, entertaining; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, contemporary
Materials: wood with birch finish, parquet-pattern veneer top, extension leaf
Colors: light warm natural wood
Shape: long rectangular top with center leaf, two trestle bases with V-shaped braces and floor stretchers, large and sturdy
Feel: warm, welcoming, relaxed
Goes with: white or cross-back chairs, white walls, black accents; farmhouse or casual modern rooms

Type: reclaimed wood slab-leg dining table
Use: dining, gatherings; dining room, kitchen
Style: rustic, modern, minimalist
Materials: reclaimed fir planks, knots visible, natural finish
Colors: honey brown warm wood
Shape: thick rectangular plank top, two wide solid panel legs, clean blocky silhouette, medium size, solid visual weight
Feel: warm, natural, simple
Goes with: black metal chairs, white walls, linen textiles; rustic modern or Scandinavian rooms

Type: octagonal pedestal dining table
Use: dining for four, conversation; dining room, kitchen, breakfast nook
Style: rustic, modern, bohemian
Materials: solid elm planks, natural weathered finish
Colors: light greyish natural wood
Shape: faceted octagonal top, tapered faceted cone pedestal base, chunky sculptural, round footprint, medium size
Feel: earthy, sculptural, warm
Goes with: woven or rattan chairs, white walls, plants; bohemian, rustic or modern rooms

Type: extendable farmhouse trestle dining table
Use: family dining, entertaining; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, coastal
Materials: pine plank top, painted distressed wood base
Colors: white base, warm honey brown top
Shape: rectangular plank top with breadboard ends, white trestle legs with diagonal braces and low stretcher, sturdy, medium to large
Feel: cozy, bright, homey
Goes with: white or wood chairs, light walls, linen textiles; farmhouse or coastal rooms
